status: Proposed for the next interview edits; not an approved rendered look

captions.language: Preserve actual spoken English/Hindi/Hinglish; manually correct ASR before word alignment
captions.placement: Lower safe area calibrated to speaker, hands and platform UI; do not reuse a universal y coordinate
captions.motion: Gentle4–6frame rise/fade, restrained shadows; no continuous bouncing
captions.accent: Warm gold on a few meaningful words; retain navy/white contrast; no clinic/NioLearn styling

speaker_identity: Name/role lower third only after reliable verification. Appearance alone does not establish parent/teacher/guest role.
broll: Actual Jet Kids footage matched to the spoken point. No event photos, fabricated classroom/library shots, evening-event continuity or unrelated stock footage.
cuts: Preserve complete words, meaning and genuine gestures. Remove interviewer setup/false starts at reviewed boundaries; do not build statements from unrelated answers.
audio: Natural original dialogue at100% speed. Conservative denoise only where needed, stable dialogue level, quiet instrumental bed with ducking; combined target around-14LUFS and <=-1dBTP. Measure and listen after render.
j_l_cuts: Use short speech bridges under relevant B-roll when the complete sentence remains clear; avoid chopping phonemes or covering a needed facial reaction.
portrait: Full-frame source-specific crop or upright native portrait; inspect head, hands and gesture throughout.
landscape: Prefer real landscape A-roll/coverage. For a true vertical cabin source, evaluate a full-frame close crop or a generous talking-head/B-roll split composition rather than silently losing the full gesture.
required_review: Correct selected dialogue, verify source/action/crop, inspect every caption and boundary, full encoded audio/visual review before recording final QA.
font_note: Existing reusable font files; new Jet Kids treatment, not the clinic caption preset.
